summary: Iteration 42: checked that the Therapist dashboard, Participant plans & safety and Team plans overview are gone, the new BBQ login photo, and the iteration-41 follow-up fixes. Backend: 60/60 pytest pass (new test_iter42 file plus the iter40 and iter41 files, run serially). All 12 old /api/dashboards and /api/agts-dashboard/* routes return 404. GET /api/dashboard returns 200 with celebrations. The backend starts cleanly, and the dashboard loop and ensure_dashboards were removed from startup. Frontend (375x667): the login screen shows the BBQ team photo (1400px) and the No Limitts logo, with no page errors. Admin home shows the 3-year anniversary greeting and the Erin birthday banner (pink to purple, readable). Employee home shows the birthday greeting and the Alex anniversary banner; tapping the banner opens the DM. Neither home has a dashboard or plans card. Library: no dashboard or plans rows; all 17 admin rows and 10 employee rows open with no errors. /plans-overview and /dashboard/therapist show Unmatched Route. Staff profile BirthdayCard: Cancel resets the typed value (05-07 goes back to 29-10). The profile PDF button opens a new tab. Team (Make Executive toggles still there), Chat, Events, Certificates and Policies all load. The 29 Feb rule is covered by the iter41 unit test, which passes.

minor.issue: Collection 'dashboards' still holds 4 docs. 'agts_dashboard_parts' and 'plan_reviews_booked' exist but are empty. Nothing reads them now. Drop them if the user confirms.

Still runs db.plan_cal_events.delete_many (backend/routes/calendar.py:68). This is a harmless leftover of plans calendar sync. Calendar events that sync already created stay in therapists' Google Calendars, so the user may need to remove them by hand.
Stale comments still describe Executive as gating the dashboards: backend/core.py:105 and backend/routes/users.py:55.

The test_iter41 celebration tests error under pytest-xdist because workers share a module fixture. They pass when run serially (-n 0).
